description: Bounded negative result for intent i005 (io-uring-sq-ring branch, snapshot s01 only). I catalogued all 64 raw non-READ_ONCE sqe-> field accesses under io_uring/ plus the SQE fetch path and per-opcode prep functions. Evidence: (1) io_get_sqe() (io_uring/io_uring.c:1978-2007) reads the SQ-array index once with READ_ONCE, bounds-checks against ctx->sq_entries, and applies array_index_nospec before indexing sq_sqes; its comment explicitly documents the subsystem invariant that validated-then-used SQE members must be read through READ_ONCE. (2) Consumed SQE scalars are single-fetched into locals/req state in every prep path examined: kbuf.c:489/508-531 (nbufs/addr/len/off/buf_group), net.c:794-825 (addr/len/ioprio/msg_flags/optlen), poll.c:834-839 via io_poll_parse_events, rw.c:277 (ioprio), io_uring.c:1727/1729/1769/1801/1814 (opcode/flags/buf_group/fd/personality), uring_cmd.c:189-222 (uring_cmd_flags/cmd_op/buf_index). (3) The remaining ~54 raw sqe-> sites (advise, cancel, fs, futex, epoll, msg_ring:263, openclose, rsrc, statx, sync, timeout, truncate, waitid, net, poll, kbuf, mock_file, cmd_net) are all 'unused-field must be zero' rejection checks where the field is never consumed afterwards - a racing write can only flip accept/reject of a never-used value. (4) The one apparent double-read, msg_ring.c:331 'CLASS(fd, f)(sqe->fd)', operates on a kernel stack copy made by copy_from_user in io_uring_register_send_msg_ring (register.c:955). No finding meets the report bar. Unresolved residue: uring_cmd helpers that dereference cmd->sqe (mock_file.c:67/213/280, cmd_net.c:29/56/155) before verification that io_uring_cmd_sqe_copy (uring_cmd.c:227 memcpy to kernel cache) always runs first; mock_file.c appears non-upstream so reachability is uncertain. The final artifact at agent-state/findings/i005.json records snapshots_checked=["s01"], execution_status complete, empty findings, ten classified candidates, and four concrete limitations.
